The hub page itself lists no products (0 product-tile matches in its rendered HTML) and exists purely to link to 12 department sub-pages, each independently confirmed documentType=CLEARANCE_CATEGORY in its own __NEXT_DATA__. Recorded genuinely uncertain per brief guidance rather than guessed either way. Checked nav/footer/sitemap broadly for any other Sale/Offers/Deals/Promotions/Discounts page -- found none besides these two.
